mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase while disulfiram inhibits aldehyde dehydrogenase and can potentiate sympathomimetic effects; combined use risks severe hypertensive crisis, psychosis, and CNS toxicity.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if both agents are clinically necessary, require specialist oversight with careful monitoring of blood pressure, mental status, and consideration of alternative agents.
